name: com.tutan.messages
description: Zero-allocation, struct-based publish/subscribe message bus for Unity 6 and XR: ref-passed handlers, disposable subscriptions, thread-safe enqueue, EventBus (N:M) and CommandBus (N:1).

samples.description: A live score driven by both buses: a button publishes commands, a background thread enqueues commands off the main thread (a coroutine on Web players), and the score UI listens for events. One self-contained scene; requires uGUI.
